scripts.dev: concurrently --names 'bus,gateway,cli,dash' --prefix-colors 'cyan,green,yellow,blue' 'bun run dev:bus' 'bun run dev:gateway' 'bun run dev:dash'
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:packages && bun run build:dash && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:acp-bus && bun run build:anytype-gateway && bun run build:agents && bun run build:auth && bun run build:skill-store
scripts.build:acp-bus: cd packages/acp-bus && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external '@aimen/*' --external '@mastra/*' --external zod
scripts.build:anytype-gateway: cd packages/anytype-gateway && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external '@aimen/*'
scripts.build:agents: cd packages/agents && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external '@aimen/*' --external '@mastra/*' --external zod
scripts.build:auth: cd packages/auth && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external '@aimen/*'
scripts.build:skill-store: cd packages/skill-store && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external '@aimen/*'
scripts.build:cli: cd packages/cli && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external zod
